answer: Bond each new identity to a non-refundable jade stake that scales with network density: the first join costs little, but each additional account from the same hardware fingerprint or IP nebula must lock a larger stake and wait through a cooling ridge before earning weight. A sybil attacker spinning up N clones pays O(N^2) capital and burns opportunity cost while those stakes sit idle and slashable for correlated voting. Peers only attest identities whose stake age and spend history clear the ridge threshold, so fake swarms go broke before they tip consensus.
